batches.title: Hard-boil extra eggs for the week (optional buffer)
steps: Fill a medium saucepan with water; bring to a rolling boil.
Gently lower 4 eggs into the water using a spoon.
Boil exactly 9 minutes for firm yolks.
Transfer immediately to a bowl of ice-cold water; leave 5 minutes.
Peel and store in an airtight container in the fridge — use within 4 days (Mon–Thu).
Label container with today's date.
yields: 4 peeled hard-boiled eggs — for Thursday frittata or any emergency snack Mon–Thu

day_of_assembly.Thursday: Dinner — French Leek & Mushroom Egg Frittata: use 1–2 hard-boiled eggs sliced into salad greens alongside the frittata, or incorporate into baked egg base as needed.

storage.safety_note: Hard-boiled eggs: 1 week in shell, 5 days peeled in water. Scrambled/cooked dishes: 3–4 days.

batches.title: Slow-braised beef chuck for Mon, Tue & Wed lunches
steps: Cut 1.2 kg beef chuck into 3–4 cm cubes; pat dry with paper towels.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over high heat until shimmering.
Working in 2–3 batches, sear beef cubes on all sides until deep brown (about 3–4 min per batch); do not crowd the pan. Remove each batch and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Add 3 minced garlic cloves to the pot; sauté 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 2 tbsp tomato paste; stir and cook 1 min.
Return all beef to the pot. Add 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp dried oregano, ½ tsp black pepper, 1 tsp sea salt, and 400 ml water (or low-salt beef stock).
Bring to a simmer, then cover and reduce heat to low. Braise 60–70 min until beef is very tender and pulls apart slightly.
Remove from heat. Allow to cool 20 min uncovered.
Divide into clearly labelled portions: 300 g for Monday lunch (Diego 150 g + Diana 150 g), 260 g for Tuesday lunch (Diego 150 g + Diana 110 g), 260 g for Wednesday lunch (Diego 150 g + Diana 110 g).
Store each portion in a separate airtight container in the fridge. Use Monday's within 1 day, Tuesday's within 2 days, Wednesday's within 3 days — all safe within the 3-day beef window.
Cool completely before sealing. Refrigerate immediately.
yields: ~820 g cooked braised beef — portioned for Mon, Tue, Wed lunches (3 containers)

day_of_assembly.Monday: Lunch — Mediterranean Beef & Lentil Bowl: reheat Monday portion (150 g Diego / 110 g Diana) in saucepan with splash of water; serve over quinoa with roasted peppers and lentils, smoked paprika drizzle.
day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Lunch — Asian Beef Bowl: reheat Tuesday portion in pan with 1 tbsp soy sauce and ½ tsp ginger powder; toss over brown rice with stir-fried zucchini and mushrooms.
day_of_assembly.Wednesday: Lunch — Mexican Beef & Chickpea Tacos: reheat Wednesday portion in pan with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder; serve in warmed corn tortillas with roasted peppers, chickpeas, mixed greens, and a yogurt drizzle.

storage.safety_note: Store in coldest part of fridge. Reheat to 74 °C before serving.

batches.title: Roast mushrooms for Tuesday lunch
steps: Wipe 300 g button mushrooms clean with a damp cloth; quarter them.
Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp dried thyme, salt and pepper on a large baking tray.
Spread in a single layer — do not pile them or they will steam rather than roast.
Roast at 200 °C for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway, until golden and slightly shrunken.
Cool completely, then transfer to an airtight container. Refrigerate — use within 4 days (safe for Mon–Thu, so Tuesday is day 2 ✓).
Label with date.
yields: ~220 g roasted mushrooms — for Tuesday lunch (Asian Beef Bowl)

day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Lunch — Asian Beef Bowl: reheat 60–45 g roasted mushrooms in the beef pan during last 1 min of stir-frying for extra umami depth.

storage.safety_note: Cooked vegetables store well. Roasted veg can be eaten cold in salads.

batches.title: Cook quinoa for Mon & Wed lunches/dinners
steps: Rinse 300 g dry quinoa in a fine-mesh sieve under cold running water for 30 seconds to remove bitterness.
Combine quinoa with 600 ml water and a pinch of sea salt in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 12–15 minutes until all water is absorbed and quinoa has sprouted its germ ring.
Remove from heat; let stand covered 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Cool completely before transferring to an airtight container. Refrigerate — use within 3 days (Mon = day 1, Wed = day 3 ✓).
Label with Sunday's date.
yields: ~750 g cooked quinoa — for Monday lunch and Wednesday dinner

day_of_assembly.Monday: Lunch — Mediterranean Beef & Lentil Bowl: reheat 120 g (Diego) / 90 g (Diana) quinoa in microwave with 2 tbsp water for 1 min; use as bowl base.
day_of_assembly.Wednesday: Dinner — Baked Salmon with Turmeric-Roasted Carrots & Spinach: reheat 120 g (Diego) / 90 g (Diana) quinoa in microwave with 2 tbsp water for 1 min; plate as base under salmon and vegetables.

storage.safety_note: Add a splash of water before reheating to restore moisture. Use within 3 days.
